methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Exact worst-case first extension degree admitting a nonsingular projective slice of a regular finite-field matrix pencil, with all-prime-power proof and bounded polynomial/literal-matrix corroboration.
scope_change_reason: The register-model exploration is narrowed to an original algebraic field-normalization side question motivated by PR5689. No BIT call identity, rank saving or native realization is claimed. The historical nonabelian census is not an input or an audit target.
bottleneck_link: Side result for algebraic native-interface exploration: exactly prices the extension-degree obstruction to invertible-slice normalization. It does not improve the selected paid moment or supply a free change of field.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified sharp threshold and attaining pencil. Do not extend to field descent, native synthesis or larger searches.
evidence: PROOF.md and standalone verify.py: 1707 homogeneous forms, 18 literal extremal pencils, 828 determinants, seven named semantic controls and six rejected inputs.
